summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Phase 1 Customer Profile Section for Medilo. All 16 backend tests pass (100%). All frontend UI tests pass. Profile icon in header, profile page with stats, address book CRUD, wishlist CRUD, and logout functionality all working correctly.

Backend: GET /api/customer/profile - returns profile with name, phone, total_orders, total_spend, address_count, wishlist_count
Backend: PUT /api/customer/profile - updates name successfully
Backend: PUT /api/customer/profile - updates email successfully
Backend: GET /api/customer/addresses - lists addresses
Backend: POST /api/customer/addresses - creates address with label, full_name, mobile, house_flat, street, city, state, pincode
Backend: PUT /api/customer/addresses/{id} - updates address
Backend: DELETE /api/customer/addresses/{id} - deletes address
Backend: POST /api/customer/addresses/{id}/set-default - sets address as default
Backend: First address auto-set as default
Backend: GET /api/customer/wishlist - returns enriched wishlist with product details
Backend: POST /api/customer/wishlist - adds product to wishlist
Backend: POST /api/customer/wishlist - duplicate add returns 400
Backend: DELETE /api/customer/wishlist/{product_id} - removes from wishlist
Backend: DELETE /api/customer/wishlist/{product_id} - nonexistent returns 404
Frontend: Homepage - Profile icon visible next to cart icon (data-testid='profile-link')
Frontend: Homepage - Cart icon works (data-testid='cart-link')
Frontend: Homepage - Bottom nav logout button present (data-testid='nav-logout')
Frontend: Homepage - Product cards have wishlist heart buttons (data-testid='wishlist-btn-{id}')
Frontend: Profile page - Shows avatar, name, phone, stats (orders, spent, addresses)
Frontend: Profile page - Menu items: My Orders, Address Book, Wishlist
Frontend: Profile page - Logout button works (data-testid='profile-logout-btn')
Frontend: Profile page - Edit profile dialog with name and email inputs
Frontend: Address Book - Shows saved addresses with label, name, address
Frontend: Address Book - Edit/Delete/Set Default buttons on address cards
Frontend: Address Book - Add address dialog with all fields
Frontend: Wishlist - Shows items with product name, category, price
Frontend: Wishlist - Cart and Remove buttons on wishlist items
critical_code_review_comments: All data-testids properly implemented for testing
Profile stats correctly calculated from orders collection (total_orders, total_spend from delivered orders)
Address book correctly implements first-address-auto-default behavior
Wishlist correctly prevents duplicate entries and returns enriched product details
customerAPI in api.js correctly implements all profile, address, and wishlist endpoints
seed_data_creation: No new seed data created. Used existing test data. One address exists (Ravi Kumar, Bengaluru). Two wishlist items exist (Vitamin D3 1000IU, Vitamin C 1000mg).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase 1 Customer Profile Section fully implemented and tested. Profile page at /profile shows name, phone, stats (orders, spent, addresses). Address Book at /profile/addresses with full CRUD (add/edit/delete, set default, labels: Home/Work/Hostel/Other). Wishlist at /profile/wishlist with Cart and Remove buttons. Heart icon on product cards toggles wishlist. Profile icon in header next to cart. Logout button on profile page and in bottom nav. Test file: /app/backend/tests/test_customer_profile.py. All data-testids: profile-link, cart-link, nav-logout, profile-card, profile-name, profile-phone, edit-profile-btn, profile-logout-btn, menu-my-orders, menu-address-book, menu-wishlist, add-address-btn, address-card-{id}, edit-address-{id}, delete-address-{id}, set-default-{id}, wishlist-btn-{id}, wishlist-item-{id}, move-to-cart-{id}, remove-wishlist-{id}.
